parts.text: As a dispatcher, I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I decide which drone flies and along which way before signing off a flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. I worry that radio coverage is patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, and that instructions sent to drones and charging equipment can get through twice while the sender cannot tell if the first attempt arrived.
